title: Dealing with movable obstructions on the course
question: Your golf ball stops against a can on the course. What should you do according to the rules?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies with the can in place.
Remove the can and, if your ball moves because of this, replace it with no penalty.
Remove the can and take a one-stroke penalty if the ball moves.
You must not move the can as it is now part of the course.

explanation: When a movable obstruction like a can is interfering, you may remove it. If your ball moves as a direct result, just replace your ball with no penalty.
